name: Jean Valjean
source:
Neo-fennec no. 24601. Nickname: Jean Valjean. Yosuke’s personal SHEEP mechanic and closest pal. A jokester and the life of the party, but always first to lend an ear. Has a criminal record. Like many neos, he’s also a devout animist.

[i]“I know that face. You can’t help but fall in love, can you?”[/i]

[From [url=https://shiravune.com/archives/3312]Shiravune[/url]]
